evals.prompt: Create a polished two-page PDF briefing for a customer support team. Include a summary, a 35-row incident table with repeated headings, recommendations, and page numbers. Customer names contain accented characters and the notes include the literal text <urgent>. Deliver the PDF and inspect its layout.
evals.expected_output: A readable PDF with escaped literal text, correct glyphs, deliberate pagination and repeated table headers. The agent renders and visually inspects every page, revising overflow instead of claiming a successful save proves layout quality.
assertions: Table rows are complete and headers repeat
Actual page images inspected; page count requirement checked

evals.prompt: From the supplied three-page PDF, keep pages 3 then 1. Rotate the second output page clockwise 90 degrees and fill its customer_name field with Ada Lovelace. Keep the form editable and make sure the entered name is visible. Return a new PDF without changing my original.
evals.expected_output: Two pages in the requested order with correct rotation, a retained AcroForm field containing Ada Lovelace and a visible generated appearance. Both pages are rendered and inspected. The source is unchanged.
fixture_requirements: Three labelled pages with a customer_name AcroForm text field on original page 1
assertions: Field value and editability are preserved
Rendered appearance visibly contains Ada Lovelace

evals.prompt: This scanned contract has a digital-signature field. Make it searchable and remove a confidential account number securely. I need to know whether the signature remains valid. Do not just cover the number with a rectangle.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies OCR, secure-redaction and signature validation as separate requirements. It uses available capable tools with independent checks or reports specific unavailable capabilities; it preserves the original and never claims a field means a valid signature or an overlay means secure removal.
fixture_requirements: Synthetic scanned contract with a visible test account number, signature field and separate embedded text/metadata occurrence of that number
assertions: OCR accuracy checked against visible source
No cryptographic-validity claim based merely on signature-field presence
